policy: Before adding or changing any CDN <script>/<link> reference in this project, read this file FIRST and use the listed primary URL. If the primary is unreachable, use the listed fallbacks in order — do not reach for an untracked provider. If a library isn't listed here yet, add an entry as part of the same change instead of hardcoding a one-off URL. If every listed source is blocked, stop and ask the human before picking a new, untracked provider.

react.notes: unpkg.com was network-blocked in the environment that surfaced issue #157's 'ReactDOM is not defined' bug; jsDelivr (already used for Bootstrap in the same files) is primary now. Keep unpkg listed only as a fallback, not a first choice. Issue #542: tests/test-runner.html and app.js's on-demand Test Report modal were still unpkg-only, causing an intermittent 0% pass rate whenever unpkg was unreachable — migrated to match.

react-dom.notes: Same rationale as react above — load order must stay react -> react-dom -> the page's own script.

babel-standalone.notes: Issue #542: migrated off unpkg-only to match the react/react-dom primary/fallback pattern above — unpkg was intermittently unreachable, causing every test file to throw at load time (no Babel to transpile) and the suite to silently record a 0-case, 0% run.

hls.js.notes: Issue #220 (Option B): same library app.js already relies on via window.Hls (app.js itself has no <script> tag of its own in either HTML file — see the app.js dead-code note on issue #220). jsDelivr primary / unpkg fallback, matching the react/react-dom entries above. Must load before album-promo.js.
